title: Linked List Cycle
description: Detect whether a linked list contains a cycle using Floyd's algorithm.

data.text: Given `head`, determine if the linked list has a cycle somewhere.

data.title: Hash Set O(n) O(n)
Two-Pointer O(n) O(1)
What improved
data.text: The hash set approach remembers every node it visits, which costs extra memory. Floyd's two-pointer technique eliminates the need for extra storage by letting one pointer move twice as fast. If there is a cycle, the fast pointer eventually laps the slow pointer and they meet inside the loop.
